products.name: Hydrating Facial Cleanser
products.description: A gentle, non-foaming cleanser for normal to dry skin. Formulated with three essential ceramides and hyaluronic acid, it removes dirt and makeup while helping restore the protective skin barrier. Fragrance-free and non-comedogenic.

products.name: Foaming Facial Cleanser
products.description: A refreshing gel-to-foam cleanser for normal to oily skin. Niacinamide, ceramides, and hyaluronic acid remove excess oil without disrupting the skin barrier. Fragrance-free and suitable for daily use.

products.name: Toleriane Hydrating Gentle Cleanser
products.description: A creamy, milky face wash for sensitive, normal to dry skin. Made with prebiotic thermal water, ceramide-3, and niacinamide to cleanse while maintaining the skin's natural moisture and pH.

products.name: SkinActive Micellar Cleansing Water
products.description: An all-in-one makeup remover and cleanser. Micelles act like a magnet to lift away dirt, oil, and makeup without harsh rubbing. No rinsing required, and gentle enough for sensitive skin and eyes.

products.name: Daily Moisturizing Lotion
products.description: A lightweight, oil-free lotion that hydrates the face and body for 24 hours. Contains three essential ceramides and hyaluronic acid, delivered with MVE technology for long-lasting moisture.

products.name: PM Facial Moisturizing Lotion
products.description: An ultra-lightweight night moisturizer with niacinamide to calm skin and improve its appearance, plus ceramides and hyaluronic acid to restore the barrier while you sleep. Oil-free and non-comedogenic.

products.name: Toleriane Double Repair Face Moisturizer
products.description: A daily face moisturizer that restores the skin barrier in one hour and provides 48-hour hydration. Formulated with prebiotic thermal water, ceramide-3, niacinamide, and glycerin. Oil-free, suitable for sensitive skin.

products.name: Revitalift Triple Power Anti-Aging Moisturizer
products.description: An anti-aging face cream with Pro-Retinol, Vitamin C, and hyaluronic acid. Targets wrinkles, firmness, and radiance for visibly younger-looking skin. Absorbs quickly and works well under makeup.

products.name: Ultra Facial Cream
products.description: A lightweight daily face cream with squalane and glacial glycoprotein that provides 24-hour hydration. Suitable for all skin types, it leaves skin soft, smooth, and comfortable.

products.name: Resurfacing Retinol Serum
products.description: A retinol serum that helps reduce the look of post-acne marks and enlarged pores. Encapsulated retinol, licorice root extract, and niacinamide brighten and smooth skin texture. Use in the evening.

products.name: Revitalift 1.5% Pure Hyaluronic Acid Serum
products.description: A lightweight, fast-absorbing serum that replumps skin with intense hydration. Pure hyaluronic acid visibly reduces wrinkles and leaves skin smooth. Fragrance-free and suitable for morning and night.

products.name: Advanced Génifique Face Serum
products.description: Lancôme's iconic serum, formulated with seven pre- and probiotic fractions and hyaluronic acid to strengthen the skin's moisture barrier. Skin looks more radiant and resilient in just seven days.

products.name: Effaclar Duo Dual Action Acne Treatment
products.description: An oil-free acne spot treatment with 5.5% micronized benzoyl peroxide and LHA. Clears acne breakouts and helps prevent new blemishes while being gentle on sensitive skin.

products.name: Minéral 89 Hyaluronic Acid Face Serum
products.description: A daily booster with 89% Vichy volcanic water and natural-origin hyaluronic acid. Strengthens and plumps skin for a healthy-looking glow. Lightweight, fragrance-free, and suitable for sensitive skin.

products.name: C E Ferulic
products.description: A daytime vitamin C serum with 15% pure L-ascorbic acid, 1% vitamin E, and 0.5% ferulic acid. Provides advanced environmental protection and improves the look of fine lines, firmness, and brightness.

products.name: Anthelios Melt-in Milk Sunscreen SPF 60
products.description: A broad-spectrum SPF 60 sunscreen for face and body with Cell-Ox Shield technology. Fast-absorbing, velvety texture that is water-resistant for 80 minutes. Suitable for sensitive skin.

products.name: AM Facial Moisturizing Lotion SPF 30
products.description: A daytime moisturizer with broad-spectrum SPF 30 mineral and chemical sunscreen. Ceramides, niacinamide, and hyaluronic acid hydrate and calm while protecting against UV damage.

products.name: Ambre Solaire Super UV Invisible Serum SPF 50+
products.description: A weightless face sunscreen serum with very high UVA/UVB protection. Leaves no white cast and works as a primer under makeup. Enriched with niacinamide and vitamin E.

products.name: Elixir Ultime L'Huile Originale Hair Oil
products.description: A luxurious hair oil infused with marula and camellia oils that adds shine, tames frizz, and protects against heat up to 230°C. Suitable for all hair types; use on damp or dry hair.

products.name: Acidic Bonding Concentrate Shampoo
products.description: A sulfate-free shampoo for damaged, chemically treated hair. Citric acid and bond-building care strengthen and repair hair bonds for stronger, shinier, more manageable hair.

products.name: Elvive Dream Lengths Conditioner
products.description: A conditioner for long, damaged hair. Made with castor oil and vitamins to detangle, strengthen, and seal split ends for smooth, healthy-looking lengths.

products.name: Fructis Hair Filler Moisture Repair Treatment
products.description: A leave-in treatment with hyaluronic acid that fills and repairs dry, damaged hair. Leaves hair softer, smoother, and more hydrated without weighing it down.

products.name: Excellence Crème Permanent Hair Color
products.description: Permanent at-home hair color with triple care protection and 100% gray coverage. Includes a pre-color protecting serum and a conditioner for rich, long-lasting, multi-tonal color.

products.name: Nutrisse Nourishing Color Creme
products.description: Permanent hair color nourished with a blend of fruit oils (avocado, olive, and shea) for intense, radiant color and soft, healthy-looking hair with full gray coverage.

products.name: Fit Me Matte + Poreless Foundation
products.description: A lightweight liquid foundation for normal to oily skin that refines pores and controls shine for a natural, seamless matte finish. Available in a wide range of shades.

products.name: Lash Sensational Sky High Mascara
products.description: A lengthening and volumizing mascara infused with bamboo extract and fibers. The flex tower brush bends to volumize and extend every single lash from root to tip.

products.name: True Match Super-Blendable Foundation
products.description: A medium-coverage foundation that precisely matches skin tone and texture. Lightweight, breathable formula with hyaluronic acid for a natural, skin-like finish.

products.name: Teint Idole Ultra Wear Foundation
products.description: A long-wear, full-coverage foundation that lasts up to 24 hours. Breathable, transfer-resistant, and sweat-resistant with a natural matte finish.

products.name: All Nighter Setting Spray
products.description: An award-winning makeup setting spray with Temperature Control Technology. Keeps makeup looking fresh for up to 16 hours without melting, fading, or settling into fine lines.

products.name: Men Expert Hydra Energetic Daily Moisturizer
products.description: A daily face moisturizer for men with caffeine and vitamin C that fights signs of fatigue and leaves skin hydrated and refreshed. Non-greasy and fast-absorbing.

products.name: Facial Fuel Energizing Face Wash
products.description: An energizing gel face wash for men with caffeine, menthol, and vitamin E. Cleanses dull, tired skin and removes excess oil for a refreshed look.

products.name: Libre Eau de Parfum
products.description: A floral lavender fragrance blending French lavender essence with Moroccan orange blossom and a warm vanilla and musk base. Bold, free, and long-lasting.

products.name: Acqua di Giò Eau de Parfum
products.description: A fresh aquatic fragrance with notes of marine accord, bergamot, clary sage, and patchouli. Inspired by the sea, sun, and Mediterranean nature.

products.name: La Vie Est Belle Eau de Parfum
products.description: A sweet gourmand fragrance with iris, patchouli, and vanilla notes. An iconic signature scent celebrating the joy of life.
